blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Thursday said an executive order to be issued by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. formalizing the government’s anti-drug stance will help legitimize the agency’s operations. “The evolving strategies and stable support system from the national government… serve as the guiding light towards aggressive operations anchored on the rule of law and due process,” PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. explained in a statement on Thursday. “For the PNP, the formalization of the government’s strategy will also reinforce the legitimacy of police operations,” he maintained.
